title: Key-talent attrition above threshold at 90 days
notes: Design §B.4: key-talent attrition tracked at 30/60/90 in phase 3; crossing the 90-day threshold escalates to the risk officer. THRESHOLD UPDATE (2026-08-24): the (c) threshold half is DECIDED by docs/decisions/2026-08-24-class-c-decisions.md (anchor gd-0024-class-c-decisions) — 90d regretted key-talent >=10% escalation, >=15% steering intervention, >=20% failure classification; numerator is regretted-only off the close-locked key-talent list. The VAR half (pmi.key_talent_attrition_90d) needs attrition-tracking schema that does not exist yet — entry stays inert until its extension round per ADR-0060 §3. Declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design (activation convention per ADR-0057). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: pmi.key_talent_attrition_90d (ratio); was dual-blocked (no var AND threshold ILLUSTRATIVE until open question (c)) — the threshold blocker is now lifted, the var blocker remains.
